proposal.receipt: Observe only nonrepeated plain Escape KEY_DOWN on the exact official player controller. Do not set Handled or prevent its delivery to the page. Record at most one in-memory receipt with creation Instant, current source document epoch and exact opaque fullscreen Grant. Receipt exists for at most500ms and one consumption. No ordinary keys, typed text, DOM input or arbitrary identifiers are recorded/logged.
proposal.nativeObservation: Only a live weak source session with a current fullscreen grant, visible/enabled exact pane and foreground main window/focus inside that pane may mint a receipt. Read modifier state only to deny modified Escape. This event callback never changes fullscreen, captures media, performs disk IO, evaluates page code, moves focus or blocks waiting for the UI thread.
proposal.delivery: Keep the page's existing trusted-event, nonrepeat, modifier, editable, IME and separate-chat exclusions unchanged. The existing source URL, bridge prefix, UUID, label and epoch checks remain prerequisites. Only Escape with enabled=false can use the receipt. At delivery recheck same epoch, same exact grant, foreground/enabled/visible native pane and focus. Take/clear the receipt once whether validation succeeds or fails. A keyup does not erase it before its asynchronous corresponding message; LostFocus does erase it.
proposal.exitIdentity: Release the exact validated grant, never read the latest session grant after queuing. Both held and released Escape require a valid exact native receipt. Missing, mismatched, expired, consumed or LostFocus-cleared receipts cannot fall back to the currently-down bit: that would let an old press for Grant A close newly acquired B. The main-window coordinator rejects stale capabilities and serializes OS mutation. Mouse/F/screenshot keep their existing physical-key gate unchanged. If the Escape observer cannot install, Escape fails closed with fixed unavailable diagnostics while the original mouse exit remains usable.
proposal.invalidation: LostFocus clears the slot. Epoch/grant replacement or closed/hidden session makes it unusable; native callback lifetime is tied to the owned controller with Weak provider state. No cross-provider or cross-pane global keyboard hook. All player controllers install the observer so a hidden scheduled receiver later attached to a viewer also works, but a hidden/recording-only player cannot mint an intent. The separate chat controller never installs this listener.
proposal.diagnostics: Retain bounded fixed action/gate logs. A successful valid receipt maps to accepted plus a fixed receipt-used boolean or fixed reason, never exposing the capability or timing payload. Expired/missing/foreign receipt leaves the original denied key_released result. No raw key logs.
